localBiteReport: The most recent verifiable Destin-area fishing reports are from Half Hitch's weekly series, with the latest confirmed post dated September 28, 2026 — just days ago — though the full bay-fishing section of that specific report was not retrievable. Based on the September 7, 2026 Half Hitch report (the most recent with readable content), the fall transition was underway with redfish and speckled trout active in the bay. October is historically one of the best months for inshore action on Choctawhatchee Bay: redfish are rated 'Great' all month, speckled trout are consistently strong, flounder typically begin showing up in earnest around the Destin harbor and dock structures by early October, and sheepshead start building to their fall peak around bridge pilings and jetties. Water temp for this area today is 85°F. The Destin Fishing Rodeo kicks off October 1, with inshore categories including redfish, flounder, sheepshead, and speckled trout all on the board.
